label: Barcode
description: Scannable 1D barcode (Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A). Orange bars on light, dark, or transparent backgrounds, with an optional human-readable caption underneath. Double-click the barcode to change what it encodes.

text.label: Payload
text.description: What the barcode encodes. Code 128: any printable text. EAN-13: 12 or 13 digits. UPC-A: 11 or 12 digits (the check digit is added when you leave it off).

format.label: Symbology
format.description: Code 128 for general-purpose text; EAN-13 / UPC-A for retail product codes.

mode.label: Background
mode.description: Light or dark ground behind the bars.

transparentBackground.label: Transparent background
transparentBackground.description: Leave the ground transparent (alpha) instead of solid light or dark.

showHumanReadable.label: Human-readable caption
showHumanReadable.description: Print the encoded digits in a band under the bars. Off = bars only.
